text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Your Harbor debit card has a standard daily point-of-sale purchase limit of $3,000, covering purchases in stores, online and by phone (Debit Card Limits and Controls, effective 2026-02-02, for Harbor Visa debit cards on Retail checking accounts). Limits reset at midnight Eastern Time, and cash back at a store counts toward this purchase limit rather than the $500 daily ATM withdrawal limit.
